bio.name: Gavin Krohman
bio.portfolioSummary:
My background splits pretty evenly between tech and creative work, and most of what I do sits somewhere in between the two. I think that's the more honest way to describe it, not a technologist who dabbles in creative projects, or the other way around, but someone who's never really separated the two.

Everything on this site started as something I wanted to build, not a brief I was given. I hope you enjoy my creations.
bio.studioSummary:
This is where I keep the stuff I build just because I want to. I've got a technical background and a creative streak, and most of what's here comes from letting those two run into each other.

Some of it's useful. Some of it's just me seeing if I can pull something off. I don't always know which until it's done, and honestly that's part of the fun.
